properties.text:
Re-share from Within Our Lifetime: “🚨ALL OUT FRIDAY AT 4 PM: Join the Global Day of Action to Defend Our Prisoners and Resist the Executions
🇵🇸 Palestinian Prisoners Day March ⛓️‍💥 Free Them All 
📍 Zionist Consulate E. 42nd & 2nd Ave

Our prisoners are the compass of our struggle, and the key to the liberation of Palestine.

Over 10,000 of our prisoners are held by the zionist entity, subjected to systematic starvation, brutal assault, and relentless torture.

Since October 7, their conditions have drastically worsened, with at least 89 Palestinian prisoners ascending to martyrdom. The situation will only further escalate following the passage of the law authorizing the execution of prisoners.

Join us in taking to the streets to demand an end to the ongoing aggression against all our people—from Gaza to Iran, Lebanon, Yemen, and Iraq—and the liberation of every single prisoner in the dungeons of the zionist entity.”

See you there to stand for the liberation of the land and for the thousands of Palestinian political prisoners suffering unimaginably in zionist captivity. 

Western mainstream media including the NYT have played a critical, deadly role in whitewashing the reality of israel’s systematically criminal, torturous apartheid detention system. 

Unsubscribe from the Times & follow Palestinian journalists @alhelou.y @zenatahhan @nahed_hajjaj99 for the truth unfiltered 🇵🇸

#StopTheExecutions #FreePalestinianPrisoners #FromTheRiverToTheSea 

Slides via: WOL on telegram (t.me/wolpalestine), @brixtonboycott4pal , @sahatenglish , @africa4palestine , @assalrad_ , @middleeasteye , @wearthepeace , @ajplus
properties.mapped_location: Palestine Way/Main Street, Paterson, Passaic County, New Jersey, 07503, United States
